discovery_context.problem: NETWORK_ERROR persistence despite vertical integration benefits
discovery_context.root_cause: AbortController early abortion due to React lifecycle timing conflicts
discovery_context.key_insight: Vertical integration solves spatial coupling but not temporal coupling

spatial_coupling.definition: Dependencies between components in the codebase structure

temporal_coupling.definition: Dependencies on execution timing and lifecycle phases
problems_caused: useEffect double execution in React 18 StrictMode

temporal_vertical_integration_protocol.core_concept: Extending vertical integration from spatial dimension to temporal dimension
temporal_vertical_integration_protocol.philosophy: Each block exists in both space (code structure) and time (lifecycle phase)

phases.hydrating: SSR to CSR transition in progress

lifetimes.transient: Exists only during specific state transitions

phase_locked_blocks.description: Blocks locked to specific execution phases
phase_locked_blocks.use_cases: Browser API dependent operations, SSR-only data fetching

lifecycle_aware_blocks.description: Blocks that adapt behavior based on current phase
lifecycle_aware_blocks.use_cases: Components that work across SSR/CSR boundary
lifecycle_aware_blocks.implementation: Custom lifecycle hooks with phase detection

quantum_blocks.description: Blocks maintaining superposition of multiple states
quantum_blocks.use_cases: Adaptive components that collapse to appropriate state on observation

abort_management.phase_conditional_abort: Only abort on specific phase transitions
abort_management.deferred_cleanup: Delay cleanup to avoid race conditions

solution: Only abort on unmount-final, not on phase transitions
voice_synthesis_fix.implementation: @TemporalBlock decorator with phase and abort configuration

debugging.temporal_tracing: Visualize block execution across time phases
debugging.phase_mismatch_detection: Identify blocks executing in wrong phases

predictability.lifecycle_isolation: Blocks protected from external lifecycle interference

gradual_adoption.opt_in_complexity: Only add temporal complexity where needed

innovation_summary.problem_class_solved: React/Next.js lifecycle complexity in large applications
innovation_summary.key_innovation: Treating time as first-class architectural dimension
innovation_summary.practical_validation: Solves persistent NETWORK_ERROR in voice synthesis

theoretical_foundation.inspiration: Quantum mechanics superposition applied to software architecture
theoretical_foundation.principle: Blocks exist in multiple potential states until observed (rendered)
theoretical_foundation.future_research: Applying quantum computing concepts to concurrent programming
